column3: Four upper rail controls share one 150ms translateX(49px) entry animation owned by the sidebar shell; the foot-pinned settings seat gets opacity only.
Overlay views drop the scrollbar-gutter reservation; the composer seat compensates with right: var(--dsh-scrollbar-width), and the Firefox residual drift is recorded as an accepted cost.
Boot-time 'duplicate loader entry id: tool-pwsh' fixed by replacing the overlay's insert with an id-targeted override (disabled: false) and disabling pwsh-sandbox by id.
Whole-session stats move into a sessionStats projection plugin counting step/end (not assistant/message); StatsLine falls back to the window fold when the key is absent.
A turn-max-tokens conversation node surfaces a truncated turn end as a warning row with no token numbers, derived from the durable event so it rebuilds on reload.
providerUsable(row) replaces the DeepSeek-only readiness check; each setup/editor/add card owns its own close handler so cancelling one does not clear the others.
candidateExists accepts an lstat-seen link-shaped reparse point so the Microsoft Store pwsh alias resolves ahead of the Windows PowerShell 5.1 fallback.
Fixture teardown unlinks every reparse point before recursive removal, after git worktree remove followed a junction and deleted the repository's tracked scripts/.
ensureSymlink removes a stale junction with unlinkSync rather than rmSync, preserving the fail-loud guarantee that a real directory is never deleted.
A sessionListMetadata projection makes blankness monotonic (true->false on turn/start); a cache miss is served blank:false and updatedAt uses lastPromptAt, not the artifact mtime.
The 260px note editor becomes a document.body-portaled popover with an anchored-position hook, because the 28px IconActions row overflowed by 168px at a 1680px viewport.
catalogProviderTakesApiKey withholds OAuth-only catalog routes from the provider directory while leaving stored profiles visible; the note records its own later retirement.
Safari's stale native textarea layout is repaired by an ordered one-pixel invalidation of the textarea then the scrollport, gated on a Safari identity plus a native-shrink signal.
A typed ReplayEnvelope makes the assembler apply one keep/drop decision to blocks and their metadata; the read side degrades unusable replay state to a foreign conversion instead of a hard error.
The backend's PROMPT_COMMAND re-asserts PS1 after the OSC 133;D marker, removing a 3.5 s per-call settle penalty caused by the tool overwriting the controlled prompt.
The standard inbox projection is the only Web transport for pending input, so a restart no longer loses accepted messages; reconnect discards retained values and watermarks before refreshing.
Every model-authored child message uses fixed Steer delivery with no quiet or next-turn model option, so a settlement notice cannot overtake an earlier child message.
The outside-click listener does not mount while searchOnExpand is set, because the initiating click reaches document during the same dispatch and collapsed the search it opened.
The openFile inject returns its promise and the chat view owns a refusal dialog with the thrown text and a Retry, so a failed handoff is no longer silent.

serializeAssistant emits reasoning_content on every reasoned assistant turn, independent of tool calls, because a gateway can recover the upstream thinking signature only by hashing the replayed chain.
beforeinput selection plus inputType supply the edit range the input machine needs, replacing the ambiguous greedy prefix/suffix scan that dropped references when '@' preceded one.
Plain-text reference marks key by their draft-order ordinal instead of their offset, so typing ahead of a reference no longer remounts every mark after the caret.
The static host serves index.html only for the dist root or the configured index path; a miss is an empty 404, so a broken asset is no longer a 200 HTML shell.
The shipped preset root moves into the plugin package and includeShippedRoot keeps the always-load guarantee off patch ordering; apps/cli no longer special-cases the roster row.
The composer's single primary control becomes Send when a running turn holds an actionable draft, while the pointer path never inherits the busy-Enter Queue/Steer preference.
The turn-error node no longer suppresses itself behind llm/retry history, so an exhausted retry chain leaves a durable terminal error row instead of a neutral collapsed notice.
A Files resolution failure rebuilds the request with base64 data URLs from the already prepared attachments under a separate 20MiB budget, with no re-encode.
One shared reference/user-text.tsx renders plain runs as spans and folds dsh-session: wire forms into chips, while the queue edit field stays literal.
readUtf16 ends its scan only when both bytes of a code unit are zero, fixing paths truncated at U+XX00 (安卓开发 -> 安卓); the fix is a verbatim community cherry-pick.
The colour-count classifier and palette PNG are deleted; one alpha bit routes to WebP or JPEG, and a shared 85/75/60 ladder replaces the downscale retry loop.
Equal-order system-prompt sections get distinct numeric orders (115, 115.5, 116, 116.5, 117) so the sequence does not depend on plugin activation order.
The token-meter surface fold becomes plan/commit: all fallible work plans, the commit is in place, and retry identity is preserved by ordering instead of a full copy.
Composer e2e gestures go through writeComposerDraft and gate on the contenteditable attribute, because Playwright's isEnabled() ignores it on a div.
toRecord stores the JSON image of a grant credential, dropping explicitly-undefined members while leaving non-finite numbers and foreign prototypes to fail loud at the store.
A non-persisted createQuestionDraftStore keeps question progress across a strict Session unmount, without putting mutable drafts on the pending carrier or in settings.
Chat node order depends on durable anchors, never on the mutable process start or answer boundary, so one logical row cannot move within a Turn.
The subagent prompt wire becomes upload-shaped PromptContentPart[] so Host admission is the only way an attachment reference can exist; the wake race is explicitly deferred.
A zero-dependency circular deque (pushBack/pushFront/popFront, doubling and quarter-full compaction) replaces Array.shift in six stream owners, making drain linear.
An extension is a media-type declaration; an extension-less path is read through ctx.fs and sniffed by file signature, and ctx.fs stays the complete path-authorization authority.
The trigger menu keeps the previous rows and marks groups pending (stale-while-revalidate); Enter during the pending window is an explicit no-op rather than a stale pick or a send.

Seven CPython-runtime findings fixed: in-flight binding calls capped at 1024 and checked once per macrotask, metadata snapshotted, the reply queue compacted mid-drain, wide values metered by cursor, and the frame parse cap derived from the host heap.
An explicit pythonBin must be an executable regular file at load, binding members are snapshotted into a null-prototype record, and the reply drain settles on a destroyed pipe.
The reply backlog is capped at 1024 pending frames and lone surrogates are counted by length difference, keeping the meter's counting-without-building contract.
The drill claim is published before execute(), because a pointer edit re-enters tracking synchronously and both readers otherwise saw the claim still clear.
writeFileAtomic retries EACCES/EBUSY/EPERM up to eight times with 20-200ms exponential delays on Windows only, leaving the existing target untouched on failure.
The picker path is decoded through a pointer-width buffer into koffi.decode(buffer, 'str16'), keeping the COM address freeable instead of scanning a fixed-size view.
A host-initiated goal pause aborts the live turn via agent.cancel({kind:'user'},{keepInbox:true}), distinguished from a model pause by ctx.agents.currentInitiator().
WorkspaceRegistry rejects non-fully-qualified paths before realpath, and the browser-safe join keeps the separator style of the drive or UNC root.
windowsHide: true is set on every non-terminal spawn and both taskkill call sites, so background process management cannot flash a console window.
remediateFsError normalises every FS_NOT_OBSERVED message to one actionable string at the dsh-tool-fs model boundary, preserving the code and chaining the source as cause.
Project-root discovery continues upward only on confirmed absence (ENOENT/ENOTDIR/FS_NOT_FOUND) and rethrows any other marker error, so identity is never guessed.
Selecting a search result returns the sidebar to normal browsing; the target row itself scrolls and acknowledges the one-shot reveal, and a new search cancels it.
goal/activation-changed exposes a process-local activation and update_goal resume refuses a durable paused goal with GOAL_TOOL_RESUME_PAUSED, so the user owns the pause.
ConnectionController warns at 3s, cancels at 15s, and retries forever with a cap growing to 10s; a maximum delay is separated from a retry-count limit.
terminalCardModel stops rejecting parentCallId so a nested shell call renders as a terminal card, while a spill notice forces conservative generic output.
Patch parsing converts native absolute and patch-relative paths to file URLs inside insert rows, because Node ESM reads a Windows drive prefix as a URL scheme.
Upstream pi-ai fields are classified as opt-in gateway controls (budget field, vllm priority, max-output support) versus catalog-owned facts (mid-convo effort, fallback models).
The reference budget is max(65536, contextWindow x 4 x 0.2); the route comes from a WeakMap fed by a local listener on the completed system-prompt/assemble waterfall.
A truncated reference is spilled through the shared spill store with a session-reference source, and the omission notice lives outside the bounded preview JSON so a small budget cannot hide it.
Environment facts (source path, Web URL, cwd) move to prompt sections ordered 10000/10100/10200, after the reusable instructions, so the cacheable prefix stays byte-identical.
The Python console entry uses subprocess.run on Windows instead of os.execvpe, after a faulthandler probe located the 0xc0000005 fault in the CRT exec call.
Catalog diagnostics are tolerated at namespace registration and checked strictly on writes, so a catalog change cannot make a provider's settings unrepairable.
targetForReference follows package-local forwarding modules, trying explicit export edges before star edges, so a one-hop package import is recognised.
A synthesised VK_MENU press between the showing notice and the blocking Show makes the dialog's window a recent-input owner, which is a documented ground for foreground activation.
Mermaid, Graphviz and SVG share an inert image canvas whose height the browser derives from the image, with 16px padding and no measurement script.
The Dockkit import-sweep exemption admits Node's unknown-.css refusal for any stylesheet, with other extensions, error codes and messages still findings.
image-tokens.ts becomes a verbatim port of the provider's v41 calculator (14px patch, 3:1 downsample, 544x544 floor, 1024-token cap, rows x (cols+1) + 2), with no alignment pad.
The route chooses each request image's dimensions from the provider's token grid and the store only resizes to that target, so pricing and the sent image come from one solver.
The terminal buffer keeps a linked sequence of strings with aggregate byte and newline counts, evicting only the oldest code points, so append cost no longer scales with retained output.
A completed-turn fork copies the contiguous prefix through the selected turn/end inclusive, so the next input's insertion is never copied without its removal.
Linux scope cleanup waits for direct-process settlement before rejecting, and a signal-zero probe must report ESRCH to establish absence; process.kill() is used so delivery errors stay separate.
A canonicalising coverage reporter rewrites non-finite end columns to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER before the blob merge, removing a phantom uncovered statement caused by Infinity serialising as null.
Diff cards derive line patches with the diff library under maxEditLength 256 and render a coarse replacement above it, with the timing table and 129-replacement regression included.
withFileLock permits one unconfirmed EPERM retry per Windows acquisition using the existing backoff, then rethrows, distinguishing a released lock from a real permission failure.
SessionManager builds one ID set per reconciliation for cache eviction and selection membership, replacing the per-cached-ID scan that made rebuilds quadratic.
Only a final path segment exactly equal to 'v1' counts as an existing version, so a base ending in /v1 no longer becomes /v1/v1/messages and v2/v4 are not inferred.
Malformed historical tool arguments become {} in the outgoing request only, following the pi-ai history conversion, so one bad call no longer blocks every later request.
On Windows the mandatory-update policy uses a native framed modal with move/resize/maximize; closing it requests application shutdown and never dismisses the policy.
Session Controller reports a typed session/writer-held code when resume hits SessionAlreadyOwnedError, recognised by Error name so no persistence dependency is required.
Native ordinary and restricted-token creation sets STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW and SW_HIDE before target code runs, and the private Node Job runner passes windowsHide: true.
The Messages serializer omits reasoning and tool-call blocks from user and tool-result input, keyed on role and block type, so recorded settlement notices do not brick later requests.
A per-Session localStorage binding keyed by the layout record's own id restores a task tab's identity after reload, guarded by a kind/contentId check and pruned on write.
The list endpoint follows a final link and judges the resolved target (containment, then directory), while every read path keeps its no-follow lstat gate.
Attachment authorisation and ZIP export select content by built-in event type, so an unknown event payload can no longer authorise an image read or export file bytes.
Unanswered tool calls get TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (or TOOL_NOT_STARTED) recorded before a failed step closes, keeping later provider requests valid without claiming success.
A parent catalog is completed from its children's headers and descriptors; a damaged child becomes a mode:'unknown' entry instead of rejecting the parent's readable history.
